description: This PHP class 'ConfigFileAPI' handles API requests for configuration file operations during the upgrade process in the OrangeHRM system. It manages registration data, writes configuration files, and verifies database connection status.

classes.name: ConfigFileAPI
classes.description: API controller class for handling configuration file updates and registration data during system upgrade.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes utility objects for registration and system configuration.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to write configuration files and verify database connection, also manages registration data sending.

methods.name: sendRegistrationData
methods.description: Sends registration data based on the current registration state, saving registration events accordingly.

methods.name: getRegistrationType
methods.description: Returns the registration type constant indicating upgrader start.
